question: What is the difference between gross margin and net margin?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-D with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-D professionals.
exampleAnswer: Gross margin = (Revenue - COGS) / Revenue. Net margin = (Revenue - All Expenses) / Revenue. In my analysis, a company had 40% gross margin but only 5% net margin, indicating high operating expenses. I recommended expense reduction initiatives.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
